hypothesis: Absolute SG&A intensity embeds structural industry differences. Ranking SG&A intensity within the current industry isolates relative cost discipline among comparable firms and may reduce sector bias and drawdown versus the raw R221 level factor.

factor.formula: within each date and current industry_l1, percentile rank of sga_ratio_4q_low among valid non-financial HS300 members using (average_rank - 1) / (valid_count - 1); higher means lower SG&A intensity relative to industry peers
factor.group_rule: current ext_hy_ths industry_l1; industries with fewer than 5 valid members are left null
factor.missing_policy: no filling, no zero substitution, no fallback to the raw R221 level factor

universe.rule: historical HS300 members excluding industry_l1 in {银行, 非银金融}
universe.industry_source: current ext_hy_ths industry snapshot; not historical PIT

control_strategy.purpose: Same non-financial universe, industry-neutral factor availability filter and execution; the factor is not scored.

related_benchmark.use: D3 correlation and G9 full-sample relative-performance gate

execution.universe: historical non-financial HS300 membership; daily snapshots from 2022

samples.recent_12m: last 252 trading-day returns of the stitched 2022-2026 curve
samples.rolling_1y: 252-trading-day rolling compounded return over the stitched 2022-2026 curve

gates.D1: industry-neutral factor coverage within historical non-financial HS300 membership over 2022-2026 is at least 90%
gates.D2: first valid value occurs by 2022-06-30 and recent-12m coverage is at least 95%
gates.D3: mean absolute monthly cross-sectional Spearman correlation with the raw R221 SG&A level factor is at most 0.70
gates.G1: discovery 2022-2024 total return is at least control + 5pp
gates.G2: discovery 2022-2024 MDD is no worse than control by more than 2pp
gates.G3: validation 2025-2026 total return is at least control - 5pp
gates.G4: full-sample rolling-1y positive rate is at least control
gates.G5: full-sample MDD is no worse than control by more than 2pp
gates.G6: full-sample total return is at least control - 5pp
gates.G7: recent 12m total return is positive and recent 12m MDD is no worse than control by more than 2pp
gates.G9: candidate full-sample total return is at least the R221 SG&A-level candidate full-sample total return minus 5pp

decision_rule: All D and G gates must pass. The percentile definition, minimum industry count of 5, universe, scoring weights, holding period and stop loss are frozen before factor construction. No post-result changes to grouping, minimum count, weights, filling, industry definition or regime filters are allowed.
known_limitations: The industry classification is a current snapshot, not a historical PIT industry series.
Financial tables are current snapshots; statutory deadlines are used because provider announcement dates are not reliable first-disclosure timestamps.
Industry-neutral ranking changes the economic question from absolute cost level to relative cost discipline and may discard useful cross-industry information.
Small industries with fewer than five valid members are intentionally left null to avoid unstable percentile estimates.
The factor is research-only until every pre-registered gate passes.
